column1: # What stands in the housing survey's photographs (cache/refs/zlb-raw; the AOK Berlin sick fund's Wohnungs-Enquete,
# 1903-1920, public domain), read off contact sheets of 480 px tiles by Claude, 11-17, for the director's notes on v7
# (a review note). The first 36 of the 127 interior photos in id order (sheets 0-2). Only what reads at that
# size: small things (a gramophone, a crucifix) are not counted. "?" unsure, "-" not in the frame (a stove is often
# behind the camera). The survey shows the fund's sick and poorest members: the bottom of the worker class, not its
# middle. Columns: room pictured (S Stube, K kitchen, C Kammer, A attic room, W workroom), beds, sofa, table (R round,
# Q square or oblong, -), cloth (F to the floor, H half way, B bare or oilcloth), case furniture, mirror, stove (T
# tiled, I iron, R range, 0 none per the text), wall clock (C carved Black Forest, R round, -), pictures, other.
